title: Quenched Algerian Myeongnan Roe Tagine
description: A briny, crumbly midnight craving dish that blends smoky grilled fish roe with savory spices and a hint of citrus, served in a traditional tagine. The egg‑free recipe highlights a delicate balance of textures and flavors.
instructions: Season the roe with salt, pepper, smoked paprika, and cumin.
Heat a grill pan and brush with olive oil, then lay the roe on the hot surface and grill for 2 minutes on each side until lightly charred.
Remove the roe and place it in a shallow, heat‑proof tagine or bowl.
Add the sliced onion, fish stock, and a pinch of sea salt to the tagine, then cover and simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in the grilled roe, lemon zest, and crumbled feta, then reduce heat to low and simmer for an additional 10 minutes.
Taste and adjust seasoning with extra salt or pepper as needed.
Remove from heat, sprinkle with chopped parsley, and serve immediately with flatbread or couscous.
